title: A beautiful experience!
text: An exceptional class! An incredible teacher, attentive, kind, and very professional, who introduced us to flamenco with passion and took us into her world. A magnificent experience, thank you for this moment!

title: Eva was very fun, multi...
text: Eva was very fun, multi lingual and has a great sense of humor.  Broke down the dance moves to make it easy.
author: Mary_N

title: Flamenco flop
text: We went into this experience knowing we could not dance, but we still had a great time. Our instructor was very patient with us.  The best part was we could better understand some of the dance steps we saw when we went to see a show that night.  If you don't take yourself to seriously, you can have fun with this experience.
author: Glenn_B

title: Rugby Girls do Flamenco Ole!!
text:
We visited  for a traditional Flamenco dance class. We are a Team of women rugby players from the U.K. we are all of different shapes and sizes and although excited about our lesson some were nervous and apprehensive.... 
Eva quickly made us feel at ease and we all had fun choosing our traditional Flamenco skirts shawls and fabulous shoes. There was a large selection of styles and sizes to suit everyone. 
Our lesson started with  warm up and intro to new people from other groups present for lesson. 
Eva was a wonderful teacher who not only taught us Technique but encouraged our enthusiasm and
author: P2322SUginal

title: Fun!  Nice instruction!  Great teacher and fun students from all over the world.
text: We worked toward a complete segment to include shoes, tapping, arms, step routine and finish.  Also, costume available.  Everyone was learning at their pace.  Great thing to do in Sevilla.
author: Robin

title: The class was excellent,...
text: The class was excellent, and the teacher was very good at teaching us the different steps and the history of Flamenco. We had so much fun with my daughter and felt proud of ourselves to accomplish a whole dance in such a short time!
author: Virginie_R

title: Excellent fun
text: Fun experience, very good tutor. Was good to learn about the origins and influences on flamenco as well as dancing.
author: Alison_B
